products.name: Heavyweight Organic Twill Overshirt
products.description: 340 GSM garment-washed organic cotton twill overshirt in deep navy. Features twin chest utility pockets, reinforced felled seams, and natural horn buttons.

reviews.author: Kabir Verma
reviews.comment: Heavy fabric drapes sharply. True to size across the shoulders.

products.name: Sculpted Ceramic & Brass Table Lamp
products.description: Hand-finished matte ivory stoneware base paired with a brushed solid brass collar, natural woven linen drum shade, and braided fabric power cord (E27 warm LED included).

reviews.author: Meera Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Throws a calm warm glow across my study desk. Packaging was rock solid.

products.name: Ballistic Commuter 22L Backpack
products.description: Water-resistant 1680D ballistic nylon commuter pack with full-grain leather trim, suspended 16-inch padded laptop sleeve, and YKK AquaGuard zippers.

reviews.author: Devika Sen
reviews.comment: Stands upright on its own and holds my laptop plus camera pouch cleanly.
